final: WITH feature_rows AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount FROM scanfeatures), total AS (SELECT SUM(traitcount) AS total_traits FROM feature_rows), ratios AS (SELECT f.zoneref, f.traitcount, 1.0 * f.traitcount / NULLIF(t.total_traits, 0) AS ratio FROM feature_rows AS f CROSS JOIN total AS t), avg_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM ratios) SELECT r.zoneref, r.traitcount, r.ratio, r.ratio - a.mean_ratio AS difference FROM ratios AS r CROSS JOIN avg_ratio AS a WHERE r.ratio > a.mean_ratio ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10.
